recipes.name: Classic Shakshuka
recipes.blurb: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, made for tearing bread into.
steps: Warm the olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and bell pepper and cook for 8 minutes until softened.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, and paprika and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, season with salt, and simmer for 8 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the whites set but the yolks stay runny.
Scatter parsley over the top and serve straight from the pan with bread.

recipes.name: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
recipes.blurb: Tall, tender stacks with crisp edges and a tang from real buttermilk.
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, beat the buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter together.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir just until combined; lumps are fine, do not overmix.
Heat a lightly greased griddle over medium heat and pour 1/4 cup of batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look dry, about 2 minutes, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats with Berries
recipes.blurb: No-cook oats that thicken in the fridge while you sleep.
steps: In a jar, combine the oats, oat milk, chia seeds, maple syrup, and vanilla.
Stir well, seal the jar, and refrigerate overnight or at least 6 hours.
In the morning, stir again and add a splash more milk if too thick.
Top with the berries and eat cold.

recipes.name: Green Power Smoothie
recipes.blurb: Spinach you cannot taste, hidden behind banana and mango.
steps: Add the banana, mango, spinach, and oat milk to a blender.
Blend on high until completely smooth, about 45 seconds.
Add the chia seeds and lime juice and pulse a few times to combine.
Pour into two glasses and drink right away.

recipes.name: Bacon Egg and Cheese Sandwich
recipes.blurb: The diner-counter classic on a toasted English muffin.
steps: Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp, then drain on paper towels.
Toast the English muffin halves until golden.
Wipe most of the bacon fat from the pan, add the butter, and cook the eggs to your liking, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Lay the cheese over the hot eggs so it melts, then stack eggs and bacon on the muffin bottom.
Close the sandwich and serve hot.

recipes.name: Mushroom and Herb Frittata
recipes.blurb: A skillet of eggs that finishes under the broiler, puffed and golden.
steps: Heat the broiler. Warm the oil in an ovenproof skillet over medium heat and cook the mushrooms and shallot for 7 minutes until browned.
Whisk the eggs with the parmesan, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Pour the eggs over the mushrooms and cook without stirring for 4 minutes until the edges set.
Slide the skillet under the broiler for 3 to 4 minutes until puffed and just set in the center.
Let it rest 2 minutes, then slice into wedges.

recipes.name: Breakfast Burrito
recipes.blurb: Eggs, beans, and cheese rolled tight and seared in the pan.
steps: Warm the beans in a small pan and mash slightly; season with salt.
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat, add the beaten eggs, and scramble softly until just set.
Lay the tortillas flat and divide the eggs, beans, cheese, and salsa down the center of each.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly into burritos.
Wipe the skillet, return it to medium heat, and sear the burritos seam-side down for 2 minutes per side until golden.

recipes.name: Savory Chicken Congee
recipes.blurb: Rice simmered low and slow into a silky, comforting porridge.
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then add it to a pot with the broth, ginger, and chicken.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer and cook for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until the rice breaks down and the porridge is creamy.
Lift out the chicken, shred it, and stir it back in. Season with soy sauce and salt.
Ladle into bowls and finish with scallions and a drizzle of sesame oil.

recipes.name: Maple Cinnamon Granola
recipes.blurb: Big crunchy clusters of oats and nuts baked until deep golden.
steps: Heat the oven to 325F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Toss the oats, almonds, and pumpkin seeds in a large bowl.
Pour over the maple syrup, melted coconut oil, cinnamon, and salt and stir until everything is coated.
Spread on the pan and press into an even layer. Bake for 22 minutes, rotating once, until golden.
Cool completely on the pan without stirring so it forms clusters, then break into pieces.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Chili and Lime
recipes.blurb: Creamy mashed avocado on crisp toast with a citrus and chili lift.
steps: Toast the sourdough until crisp and golden.
Mash the avocado with the lime juice, salt, and pepper until spreadable but still chunky.
Pile the avocado onto the toast and spread to the edges.
Finish with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of red pepper flakes.

recipes.name: Spinach and Feta Egg Muffins
recipes.blurb: Crustless mini frittatas baked in a muffin tin for grab-and-go mornings.
steps: Heat the oven to 375F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin well.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and pepper.
Divide the spinach, feta, and tomatoes among the muffin cups, then pour the egg mixture over the top.
Bake for 20 minutes until puffed and set in the center.
Cool 5 minutes before lifting out; serve warm or refrigerate for the week.

recipes.name: Banana Walnut Baked Oatmeal
recipes.blurb: A warm, sliceable oatmeal casserole that tastes like banana bread.
steps: Heat the oven to 350F and grease a baking dish.
Stir the oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt together in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix the mashed banana, almond milk, and maple syrup, then fold in most of the walnuts.
Combine wet and dry, pour into the dish, and scatter the remaining walnuts on top.
Bake for 30 minutes until set and golden, then let cool slightly before slicing.

recipes.name: Huevos Rancheros
recipes.blurb: Fried eggs over crisp tortillas drowned in a smoky tomato salsa.
steps: Cook the onion, jalapeno, and garlic in 1 tbsp oil until soft, then add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes; season with salt.
Warm the black beans in a small pan and lightly mash.
In another pan, fry the tortillas in the remaining oil until crisp, then set aside.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up in the same pan.
Layer beans on each tortilla, top with eggs, and spoon the salsa generously over everything.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
recipes.blurb: Cold-smoked salmon, cream cheese, and capers on a chewy toasted bagel.
steps: Toast the bagel halves until golden and crisp at the edges.
Spread a thick layer of cream cheese over both cut sides.
Drape the smoked salmon over the bottom half and scatter with red onion and capers.
Squeeze over the lemon, grind on black pepper, and close the bagel.

recipes.name: Masala Omelette
recipes.blurb: A spiced Indian omelette folded around onion, chili, and fresh herbs.
steps: Beat the eggs with the turmeric, salt, onion, tomato, chili, and cilantro.
Heat the oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and swirl to coat the pan.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the bottom is set, then fold in half and cook 1 minute more.
Slide onto a plate and serve hot.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
recipes.blurb: A thick, creamy shake that drinks like dessert but fuels a morning.
steps: Add the banana, peanut butter, almond milk, and oats to a blender.
Blend on high until thick and smooth.
Taste and add maple syrup if you want it sweeter.
Pour into a glass and dust with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Eggs Benedict
recipes.blurb: Poached eggs and ham on muffins under a blanket of hollandaise.
steps: Whisk the 2 yolks with the lemon juice over a pot of barely simmering water, slowly streaming in the melted butter until thick; season with salt and cayenne and keep warm.
Bring a wide pan of water with the vinegar to a gentle simmer. Swirl and slip in the eggs one at a time, poaching 3 minutes for runny yolks.
Toast the muffins and warm the ham in a dry pan.
Top each muffin half with ham and a poached egg.
Spoon the hollandaise over the eggs and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Steel-Cut Oats with Apple
recipes.blurb: Chewy, nutty oats simmered with sweet apple and warm spice.
steps: Bring the water and salt to a boil, then stir in the oats and reduce to a simmer.
Cook uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and tender.
Add the apple, cinnamon, and maple syrup and cook 5 more minutes until the apple softens.
Spoon into bowls and add more maple syrup to taste.

recipes.name: Tofu Scramble
recipes.blurb: Crumbled tofu cooked with turmeric for a golden, eggy vegan plateful.
steps: Press the tofu to remove excess water, then crumble it into rough pieces.
Warm the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the tofu, turmeric, garlic powder, and salt and cook for 6 minutes, stirring, until heated through and lightly golden.
Stir in the spinach and nutritional yeast and cook until the spinach wilts.
Serve hot, with toast or tortillas if you like.

recipes.name: Dutch Baby Pancake
recipes.blurb: One dramatic puffed pancake that rises in the oven and collapses on the table.
steps: Heat the oven to 425F and put a cast-iron skillet inside to heat.
Blend the eggs, flour, milk, sugar, vanilla, and salt until smooth and let the batter rest 5 minutes.
Carefully add the butter to the hot skillet and swirl until melted and foamy.
Pour in the batter and bake for 18 to 20 minutes until dramatically puffed and golden.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve at once, before it deflates.

recipes.name: Breakfast Quesadilla
recipes.blurb: Scrambled eggs and cheese crisped between a folded tortilla.
steps: Melt half the butter in a skillet and softly scramble the eggs with a pinch of salt, then set aside.
Wipe the pan, add the rest of the butter, and lay the tortilla flat over medium heat.
Sprinkle cheese over one half, top with the eggs and scallions, and add a few dashes of hot sauce.
Fold the tortilla over and cook 2 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve.

recipes.name: Chia Pudding with Mango
recipes.blurb: Coconut chia pudding set overnight and crowned with ripe mango.
steps: Whisk the chia seeds, coconut milk, maple syrup, and vanilla in a jar.
Let it sit 5 minutes, then whisk again to break up any clumps.
Seal and refrigerate overnight until thick and set.
Stir, divide between two glasses, and top with diced mango.

recipes.name: Croque Madame
recipes.blurb: A grilled ham and cheese under bechamel, finished with a fried egg.
steps: Melt 2 tbsp butter, whisk in the flour, then slowly add the milk to make a smooth bechamel; stir in the mustard and half the cheese.
Spread bechamel on two slices of bread, layer on ham and some cheese, then close the sandwiches.
Top each sandwich with more bechamel and the rest of the cheese, then bake at 400F for 10 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Fry the eggs in the remaining butter to your liking.
Set a fried egg on each sandwich and serve hot.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash
recipes.blurb: Crisp-edged sweet potato cubes with peppers and a nest for eggs.
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet and add the sweet potato. Cook covered for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the onion, pepper, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper and cook uncovered for 8 minutes until the potato is tender and crisp at the edges.
Make four wells in the hash and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook 5 minutes until the eggs set to your liking, then serve from the pan.

recipes.name: Yogurt Parfait with Granola
recipes.blurb: Layers of thick yogurt, crunchy granola, and bright fruit in a glass.
steps: Spoon half the yogurt into a glass.
Add a layer of granola and half the berries.
Repeat with the remaining yogurt, granola, and berries.
Drizzle honey over the top and serve right away so the granola stays crunchy.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
recipes.blurb: Plump shrimp tossed with linguine in a glossy lemon-garlic butter.
steps: Cook the linguine in salted boiling water until al dente, reserving 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
Melt the butter in a large skillet, add the garlic and red pepper flakes, and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Toss in the pasta, lemon juice, and a splash of pasta water until everything is glossy.
Stir through the parsley, season with salt, and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken Stir-Fry with Broccoli
recipes.blurb: Tender chicken and crisp broccoli in a quick savory sauce.
steps: Toss the chicken with the cornstarch. Mix the soy sauce and oyster sauce with 1/4 cup water to make the sauce.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 4 minutes until golden, then remove.
Add the broccoli with a splash of water, cover, and steam 3 minutes until bright green.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry 30 seconds, then return the chicken.
Pour in the sauce and toss for 2 minutes until thickened and glossy, then serve over rice.

recipes.name: Black Bean Tacos
recipes.blurb: Smoky spiced black beans piled into warm tortillas with crunchy slaw.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin, and paprika and cook 1 minute.
Add the beans with a splash of water and simmer 8 minutes, mashing some for a creamier texture.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice and a pinch of salt to make a quick slaw.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable.
Fill the tortillas with beans and top with the slaw.

recipes.name: Pad Thai
recipes.blurb: Rice noodles tossed in a sweet-tangy tamarind sauce with peanuts and lime.
steps: Soak the rice noodles in hot water until pliable, then drain. Stir the tamarind, soy sauce, and sugar into a sauce.
Heat the oil in a wok and fry the tofu until golden, then push to one side.
Crack in the eggs and scramble briefly, then add the drained noodles and the sauce.
Toss over high heat until the noodles absorb the sauce, about 3 minutes.
Fold in the bean sprouts and scallions, then serve topped with peanuts and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Sausage and Vegetables
recipes.blurb: Sausage, peppers, and potatoes roasted together on one tray.
steps: Heat the oven to 425F. Toss the potatoes with half the oil, oregano, garlic powder, and salt and roast for 10 minutes.
Add the peppers, onion, and sausage to the pan and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Roast for 18 to 20 minutes, turning once, until the sausage is cooked through and the vegetables are tender and browned.
Serve straight from the pan.

recipes.name: Caprese Pasta Salad
recipes.blurb: Tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil tossed with pasta in a bright dressing.
steps: Cook the fusilli in salted water until al dente, then drain and rinse under cool water.
Whisk the olive oil, balsamic, garlic, and salt into a dressing.
Toss the pasta with the tomatoes, mozzarella, and dressing.
Fold in the basil just before serving so it stays fresh.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Salmon Bowl
recipes.blurb: Glazed salmon over rice with quick-pickled cucumber and edamame.
steps: Stir the soy sauce, honey, and ginger together for the glaze. Toss the cucumber with the rice vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Sear the salmon in the oil skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip and cook 3 minutes more.
Pour the glaze into the pan and spoon it over the salmon until thick and shiny.
Warm the edamame in boiling water for 2 minutes.
Serve the salmon over rice with the edamame and pickled cucumber.

recipes.name: Margherita Flatbread
recipes.blurb: Crisp flatbread with tomato, melted mozzarella, and fresh basil.
steps: Heat the oven to 450F and place the naan on a baking sheet.
Spread tomato sauce over each, then sprinkle with garlic powder and a little salt.
Lay the mozzarella slices on top and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 10 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and the edges are crisp.
Scatter with fresh basil and slice to serve.

recipes.name: Chickpea Coconut Curry
recipes.blurb: Creamy spiced chickpeas simmered in coconut milk, ready in half an hour.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, and curry powder and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes until thickened.
Add the chickpeas and coconut milk and simmer 12 minutes until rich and creamy.
Fold in the spinach and cook until wilted.
Season to taste and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli
recipes.blurb: Tender strips of beef and broccoli in a rich savory stir-fry sauce.
steps: Toss the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornstarch. Mix the rest of the soy sauce, oyster sauce, brown sugar, and 1/4 cup water for the sauce.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and sear the beef for 2 minutes until browned, then remove.
Add the broccoli with a splash of water, cover, and steam 3 minutes.
Add the garlic, return the beef, and pour in the sauce.
Toss for 2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats everything, then serve over rice.

recipes.name: Greek Chicken Bowl
recipes.blurb: Lemon-oregano chicken over rice with cucumber, tomato, and tzatziki.
steps: Toss the chicken with the lemon juice, oregano, garlic, 2 tbsp oil, and salt and let it sit 10 minutes.
Heat the remaining oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Rest the chicken 5 minutes, then slice.
Divide the rice among bowls and top with chicken, cucumber, and tomatoes.
Add a generous spoonful of tzatziki to each bowl.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.blurb: Spaghetti slicked with garlic-infused olive oil and a kick of chili.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
Meanwhile, gently warm the olive oil with the garlic over low heat until the garlic is pale gold, then add the red pepper flakes.
Add the drained spaghetti to the pan with a splash of pasta water and toss vigorously to emulsify.
Stir through the parsley, season with salt, and serve.

recipes.name: Veggie Quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Crisp tortillas stuffed with peppers, corn, beans, and melted cheese.
steps: Cook the bell pepper in the oil for 4 minutes, then add the beans, corn, cumin, and salt and cook 3 minutes more.
Lay a tortilla in a dry skillet over medium heat, sprinkle half with cheese, then add the veggie filling and more cheese.
Fold over and cook 2 minutes per side until crisp and golden and the cheese melts.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas, then cut into wedges and serve.

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Cod with Couscous
recipes.blurb: Flaky baked cod over fluffy couscous brightened with lemon and herbs.
steps: Heat the oven to 400F. Place the cod on a lined tray, drizzle with 1 tbsp oil, the garlic, lemon zest, and salt.
Bake the cod for 12 to 14 minutes until it flakes easily.
Meanwhile, bring the broth to a boil, stir in the couscous, cover, and remove from heat for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Stir the lemon juice, remaining oil, and parsley into the couscous.
Serve the cod over the couscous with extra lemon.

recipes.name: Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.blurb: Crispy tofu and crunchy vegetables in a quick ginger-soy sauce.
steps: Press the tofu, cube it, and toss with the cornstarch. Fry in 2 tbsp oil until golden and crisp on all sides, then remove.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the carrot, pepper, and snap peas over high heat for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Return the tofu, add the soy sauce and a splash of water, and toss for 2 minutes.
Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.name: Turkey Taco Skillet
recipes.blurb: Everything-in-one taco filling with rice and beans in a single pan.
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion in the oil over medium-high heat, breaking it up, for 6 minutes.
Stir in the chili powder and cumin and cook 1 minute.
Add the rice, beans, tomatoes, and broth and bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook 18 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff and serve with your favorite taco toppings.

recipes.name: Sesame Soba Noodle Salad
recipes.blurb: Cold buckwheat noodles tossed in a nutty sesame-ginger dressing.
steps: Cook the soba noodles per the package, then drain and rinse under cold water until cool.
Whisk the soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and ginger into a dressing.
Toss the noodles with the carrot, cucumber, scallions, and dressing.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve chilled.

recipes.name: White Bean and Kale Soup
recipes.blurb: A brothy, garlicky soup of creamy white beans and tender kale.
steps: Cook the onion and carrot in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and thyme and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and beans, bring to a boil, then simmer 10 minutes.
Mash some of the beans against the pot to thicken the soup.
Stir in the kale and cook 5 minutes until wilted and tender.
Season with salt and serve.

recipes.name: Pesto Gnocchi with Cherry Tomatoes
recipes.blurb: Pillowy gnocchi tossed in basil pesto with blistered tomatoes.
steps: Boil the gnocchi until they float, about 2 to 3 minutes, then drain, reserving a little cooking water.
Heat the oil in a skillet and cook the tomatoes for 4 minutes until they blister and burst.
Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds, then add the gnocchi.
Stir in the pesto and a splash of cooking water until everything is coated.
Top with parmesan and serve.

recipes.name: Black Pepper Chicken
recipes.blurb: Peppery, garlicky chicken stir-fried with crisp onion and celery.
steps: Toss the chicken with the cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Heat the oil over high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until golden, then remove.
Stir-fry the onion and celery for 3 minutes until crisp-tender, then add the garlic and black pepper.
Return the chicken, add the remaining soy sauce and a splash of water, and toss 2 minutes until glossy.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Halloumi and Chickpea Salad
recipes.blurb: Golden seared halloumi over chickpeas, greens, and a lemon dressing.
steps: Pat the halloumi dry and sear in a dry nonstick pan for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, and oregano into a dressing.
Toss the greens, chickpeas, tomatoes, and cucumber with the dressing.
Top the salad with the warm halloumi and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Miso Butter Udon
recipes.blurb: Slippery udon noodles tossed in a savory, glossy miso butter sauce.
steps: Cook the udon according to the package, then drain, reserving 1/4 cup of the cooking water.
Melt the butter in a pan, add the garlic, and cook 30 seconds.
Whisk in the miso, soy sauce, and reserved water until smooth.
Toss the udon in the sauce until glossy and well coated.
Finish with scallions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Fajitas
recipes.blurb: Sizzling strips of chicken and peppers roasted hot and fast.
steps: Heat the oven to 425F. Toss the chicken, peppers, and onion with the oil, chili powder, cumin, paprika, and salt.
Spread in a single layer on a sheet pan.
Roast for 20 minutes, stirring once, until the chicken is cooked and the edges char slightly.
Squeeze over the lime juice and serve with warm tortillas.

recipes.name: Creamy Tuscan Salmon
recipes.blurb: Seared salmon in a garlicky cream sauce with spinach and sun-dried tomato.
steps: Season the salmon with salt and sear in the oil for 4 minutes per side, then remove.
In the same pan, cook the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute.
Pour in the cream and parmesan and simmer 3 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Return the salmon to the pan, spoon the sauce over, and warm through before serving.

recipes.name: Red Lentil Dahl
recipes.blurb: Velvety red lentils simmered with tomato and warm spices.
steps: Rinse the lentils until the water runs clear.
Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, and turmeric and cook 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, and broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce to a simmer and cook 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils break down and the dahl is thick.
Season with salt and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Buffalo Cauliflower Wraps
recipes.blurb: Crispy baked cauliflower in spicy buffalo sauce, wrapped with cool ranch slaw.
steps: Heat the oven to 450F. Whisk the flour, milk, garlic powder, and a pinch of salt into a batter.
Dip the cauliflower in the batter, then arrange on a lined tray and bake 20 minutes until crisp.
Toss the baked cauliflower in the buffalo sauce and bake 5 minutes more.
Mix the cabbage with the ranch dressing to make a slaw.
Fill the tortillas with cauliflower and slaw, then roll up and serve.

recipes.name: Thai Basil Chicken
recipes.blurb: Fiery minced chicken with garlic, chili, and fragrant basil over rice.
steps: Heat the oil over high heat and fry the garlic and chili for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce, and sugar and cook 2 minutes.
Turn off the heat and fold in the basil until just wilted.
Serve over rice, with a fried egg on top if you like.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.blurb: Creamy arborio rice stirred slowly with earthy mushrooms and parmesan.
steps: Cook the mushrooms in 1 tbsp butter until browned, then set aside.
In the same pan, cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and rice and stir 1 minute until the rice is glossy.
Add the warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed before adding more, for about 18 minutes.
When the rice is creamy and just tender, stir in the mushrooms, parmesan, and remaining butter.
Season with salt and serve right away.
